messages:
kiran: Heads up  we rolled the stateful firewall rewrite at 08:10 and now a subset of warm-pool GPU nodes in us-west-2 are failing to complete keystore handshakes during bootstrap. join rate dropped ~35% in az-a. seeing conntrack exhaustions on the edge NATs.

ethan: can you paste the error logs?

kiran: snippet from controller/keystore-proxy: 
```
ERROR keystore.conn region=us-west-2 node=wp-18 msg='keystore tcp reset' dst=vpce-0keystore session_err=conntrack_table_full
WARN warmup.join node=wp-18 reason='keystore handshake timeout'
```

meera: ops metrics: NAT conntrack usage spiked after rewrite because the firewall started rewriting source ports per-flow, which prevented connection re-use. warm-pool does many short-lived TLS handshakes to the keystore and audit-shipper, so 10k ephemeral sockets are now unique tuples and overflow the conntrack table.

olivia: that explains why nodes time out during bootstrap. detection = conntrack high-water + TLS handshake failures. root cause = firewall rewrite behavior + warm-pool connection pattern.

raj: mitigation options: (1) increase conntrack table on NATs as short-term (fast), (2) revert rewrite so source ports are preserved (safer long-term), (3) add a regional keystore proxy with connection pooling to reduce per-node ephemeral sockets (medium-term). recommend (1) + (3).

kiran: cost note: scaling conntrack on managed NAT appliances is low infra cost but operational risk; proxy option adds instance + egress cost ~ $600-1.1k/day. audit shipper traffic amplification risk remains.

ethan: immediate plan: a) raise conntrack limit on edge NATs (0-15m), b) apply iptables conntrack timeout tuning for ESTABLISHED (15-45m), c) launch small connection-pooling proxy canary in us-west-2 (30-90m). raj can you file the FW-CR to revert rewrite if needed?

raj: filing CR now: FW-CR 6437 'stateful-rewrite-conntrack-mitigation' TTL=120m. also creating infra ticket PROXY-221 to spin up pooling proxy canary (n=2 t3-medium) in az-a.

ops-bot: INC-9123 created for warm-pool join failures. Linked FW-CR 6437 and PROXY-221. Estimated cost impact $750/day if proxy used. Escalate to security@redwood if FW-CR TTL > 4h.

meera: applied conntrack bump on staging NATs and warm-pool join recovered to ~96% in canary. applying to prod NATs now. monitoring connection churn and table utilization.

olivia: while bumping conntrack, please set a conservative TTL and ensure kernel slab growth doesn't OOM. also add ephemeral metric alert for conntrack usage so we can auto-scale or roll back quickly.

ethan: proxy canary result: pooling proxy reduced outbound socket churn by ~72% and keystore TLS sessions were reused. joins in canary fleet are stable. PROXY-221 will be promoted if prod NAT bump shows signs of going above safe thresholds.

raj: security note: the firewall rewrite was intended to enforce stateful inspection per-tenant. reverting it has policy implications. if we keep rewrite, we must adopt pooling proxies or increase central NAT capacity. I've added `security@redwood` to FW-CR 6437 for signoff.

meera: also, audit shipper traffic has spiked because messages get retried when handshake fails. we need to watch egress billing and set a temporary cap. billing estimates $400-900/day extra for retries until joins stabilize.

olivia: temporary controls: 1) conntrack bump applied TTL=2h, 2) proxy canary running, 3) FW-CR 6437 holds rollback option. we'll remove conntrack bump after proxy promotion or rewrite revert.

ethan: followups to capture: - add connection-pooling for keystore client in warm-pool nodes - add conntrack usage canary to infra rollout gating - add cost alert for keystore/audit retry egress - add runbook entry for firewall rewrite rollbacks with safety checks

ops-bot: INC-9123 updated: status=mitigating mitigation='conntrack bump + proxy canary + FW-CR 6437' est-resolve=+4h. linked followups PROXY-221, RB-998 (runbook), BILL-432 (egress cap).

raj: I will coordinate sec review for either reverting the rewrite or accepting proxy pattern. if sec opts to keep rewrite, PROXY-221 scope increases to regional pool.

olivia: good. I'll draft the incident notes and postmortem template. please keep the FW-CR TTL enforced and tag any cost with `keystore-conntrack-incident` for billing. closing thread once proxy promoted or rewrite reverted and conntrack metrics stabilized for 6h.

meera: metric update 45m later: conntrack usage back to normal after bump + proxy canary; keystore handshake errors dropped by 88%. continuing monitoring.

kiran: thanks team. I'll file the postmortem and assign the followups.
